entities.title: Readers
entities.summary: Everyone who opens a repository in the browser.
entities.interest: Understand a repository quickly, trust what they read to the degree its evidence allows, and share exactly what they are looking at.

entities.title: The owner
entities.summary: Owns human-assisted software development and the browser, and decides what changes.
entities.interest: That the browser shows everything the skills and the catalogue define, and that the methodology is easy to adopt.
entities.reach: Pull requests and issues on this repository.

entities.title: Agents that write .dev files
entities.summary: Keep the files the browser reads, in the repositories it shows.
entities.interest: What they record, including fields no schema names, is seen by the people they work for.
entities.influence: Consulted through the schemas: the browser shows what the schemas allow.
entities.reach: The skills in Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge.

entities.title: The designer
entities.summary: Makes a design pass over the browser.
entities.interest: Everything the browser does, for whom, and what must not change, in one place.
entities.influence: Proposes the design; the owner decides.
entities.reach: This folder's .dev files, read in the browser itself.
